threshold.bound: immutable installed tree ≤ 80 MB; mandatory-closure inventory enumerated
threshold.qualitativeHalf: zero undeclared dependencies is DR-126 / G22 (v16 ID-DEP-K2). This specification records inventory completeness structure and does not decide L-TCB identity.

harness.measures: The immutable installed tree of the default install. v16 inventorySchema.everyReleaseMustPublish members that this gate owns: complete mandatory file/dependency/TCB inventory and layer assignment; exact installed closure size.
harness.exactByteIntent: Per platform: a digest-pinned inventory graph matching v16 inventorySchema.graphRules, the installed-tree raw byte count with accounting method named but not invented here, and a layer assignment for every node. The fixture pins the inventory bytes. It does not pin 83886080 as an authorized threshold.
harness.passProperty: For each of the four platforms, every published file node is in the inventory, layer-set cardinality obeys v16 graphRules, and the shared executable if present is exactly one {L-DIST, L-HOST} node. Size comparison to 80 MB is scored only after a D-006 unit-and-accounting successor.
failsIf: a published file is absent from the inventory
duplicate path or duplicate sha256 under a different path
an exclusive-layer violation (L-EVAL or L-COMP co-occurring with another layer, other than the lawful {L-DIST, L-HOST} shared executable)
this specification is read as deciding L-TCB identity
this specification is read as authorizing 83886080 as the D-006 bound
harness.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not populate the per-OS TCB table. Does not retarget DR-126.

authorityClaim: Thin extraction of one harness from the independently reviewed parent. The parent is the review subject. This file exists so the D-086 promised artifactPathWhenAuthored is occupied at v2. It binds NOTHING.
